notes.title: OVERWORLD Update is online
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/eeb17d74b8b1c1a95f49ed1048f56c05972df687.png[/img]

You Are The Dinner now allows to fight zombies throughout the USA. Players can now choose one of the regions with different features at the beginning of the game and play the game in this region.

The USA is now divided into 9 different regions in terms of survivor effectiveness, military infrastructure, wealth of resources and zombie danger.

The changes in these regions make a significant difference to the game. You can deal with the weak zombie outbreak in the first zone more easily, but in the ninth zone, the zombies can flow on you like a raging river.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/ffa401074222d287ccdecfa0dd6f2941e71b6334.jpg[/img]

In future updates, the player will be able to travel between regions during missions.

[h2]Other changes are also online with this update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A trailer has been added to the opening of the game.
[*] When you use the gems to escape from the zombies, a control animation will appear showing how long you have distracted the zombies.
[*] Armor... The player will now be able to protect himself from the bites of zombies for a while by using the armors he finds.
[*] In Control Panel, you can see the armor value at the top of the player's health data. The player will be able to carry a certain maximum armor at each Level. It is possible to use armor without exceeding this maximum value.
[*] MOD objects will now give different abilities to the player. With these mods that fall over dead zombies, you can shoot faster, make your bullets more deadly, increase your armor level, or sell your loot items for a higher price by hacking the Trade Network.
[*] Added GUI sounds for different operations.
[*] Lots of new sounds and music have been added to enhance the in-game ambiance.
[/list]

[h3]Weapon stats are now clearly visible in the Control Panel:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon damage power
[*] The effect of the mod that increases the damage power.
[The duration of the mod that increases the damage power.

[*] [b]RoF- Rite of Fire level.[/b]
[*] The effect of the mod that increases the rate of fire
[*] The duration of the mod that increases the rate of fire.
[/list]

[h2]TRADE NETWORK HACK[/h2]
Will there be a global network in the world and hackers will not hack it? Of course, even in the zombie apocalypse, hackers are at work. 

With some handmade hardware and software to [b]hack [/b]Trade Network you can sell your items for higher price when selling on Trade Network. The control indicators for this feature are not yet in the game, but you can see that the prices on the Trade Network have changed when you use the hack mods in your inventory. 

But you have to be quick to sell. Because counter operators who notice and close the [b]backdoors [/b]on the Trade Network will eventually cut your connection.

Our new updates will be online soon.

Thank you very much for [b]supporting [/b]You Are The Dinner during its early access period.

[i]Video games are a unique piece of art that has changed the world forever, and we are making this revolution together with gamers all over the world.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/18ad275e8c86e71638d4d94b3770869d7bab7ab1.png[/img]

notes.title: INVENTORY UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/fd900d4311b5c6a449ba8ebe87bd3850d3214a9e.png[/img]

[h3][b]CIVILIZATION NEEDS THESE LOOTS!
[/b][/h3]
We are in a world where the Third World War has turned into a [b]biological warfare and Zombie pandemic[/b]. And under these conditions, factories do not work, production cannot be made. 

Even military materials / ammunition can be produced under very difficult conditions.

Billions of people have tried to escape cities and swarms of Zombies, taking their valuable and useful [b]belongings [/b]with them.

Unfortunately, only very few succeeded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/9493c76939120c3d740c51379b6b4dcc61d192cd.png[/img]
And now the streets are filled with precious [b]objects [/b]falling from people who have turned into Zombies.

Sometimes a pocketknife... Or a wrench. Maybe they desperately wanted to use it as a weapon against a zombie. but it has now turned into a [b]Loot[/b].

After a World War apocalypse in which the production capacity of human civilization approached zero, now every piece of stuff that falls from the Zombies has become a crucial resource for re-establishing our civilization. 

Don't waste these [b]resources[/b], soldier.


[h3][b]INVENTORY UPDATE IS ONLINE[/b][/h3]

With the Version 0.8 update, our players now have an advanced and powerful [b]Inventory/Loot[/b] system.

Players now have an inventory on their own as well. They also have a [b]Stash [/b]in the [b]base area[/b] where they can store their excess items.

The player can sell "Loot" objects dropped from Zombies in the base area, as well as gain an advantage against Zombies by using these objects during missions.

Each loot is [b]uniquely [/b]included in the game with the rules of [b]procedural generation[/b]. In other words, the chance of finding an object falling from a zombie again is almost negligible.

[i]The changes, additions and fixes made in the game with this update are as follows:[/i]

[h3][b]NEW:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Loot, inventory and trade mechanism has been added to the game
[*] Each Loot object has its own unique values.
[*] Each Loot object has different Rarity values.
[*] All Loot objects can interact with the mouse.
[*] There is information about objects with colored texts.
[*] In the Base region, there is a large Stash belonging to the player.
[*] Added the ability to evade Zombies by distracting them with shiny gems and jewels. When you run out of bullets, there is no other solution but to run.
[/list]


[h3][b]Enhancements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Abilities prices increased. Thus, the gameplay is balanced.
[*] Added flying texts showing money paid or received while trading.
[*] Player sprite is highlighted with outline. Thus, it became easier to see the player in crowded and bloody conflict screens.
[*] Loot drop rates have been balanced.
[*] The Inventory/wallet module on the yellow panel has been updated with its new interface, making it more readable and more useful.
[*] Open field/wind ambient sounds have been added to the game.
[*] Added a few pieces of random Loot around the Base area at game launch.
[*] Keyboard/Mouse Map has been updated.
[*] AMMO PANEL interface has changed.
[/list]


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem in the save/load system.
[*] Sniper ability has been fixed.
[*] Fixed the issue where the cursor was stuck during the player's rapid-fire.
[*] The problem of the Options menu not opening in some cases has been fixed.
[*] Fixed a small number of sprites appearing broken in some cases.
[*] Fixed some zombie sounds that stuck and caused problems in some situations.
[/list]

notes.title: Inventory system coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/fa301bc55e5348cd1bdd44561646bb52810d33cd.png[/img]

[b]The inventory system[/b] is an important mechanism for a RPG, but a detailed inventory system also means a huge [b]workload [/b]for the devs. That's why we don't see a detailed, deep, rich inventory system in most games.

Experienced gamers may have seen that even the giant AAA studios, which make games with budgets of tens of millions of dollars, lower their limits when it comes to the[b] inventory / loot system[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/5cd7ddd5de0ee29858a8716f1f335884d4ab5762.png[/img]

This is because each item added to the game has the potential to actually increase the workload in the game development process exponentially. 

Developers have to act not only to create these objects visually and add them to the code of the game, but also to consider the detailed mechanisms such as the definitions of the objects, their functions, their roles in the game setup. This means a heavy workload for the team.

[h2]But...
[/h2]
Of course, when we decided to bring "You Are The Dinner" to the players, we were aware of these workloads and organized our plans in this way. 

Now it's time to [b]integrate [/b]that full, rich inventory system into the game. 

We are preparing to open the inventory system that we have been working on for a long time to our players soon, and we wanted to share this news with our supporters who follow the game.

[b]Thank you again for supporting You Are The Dinner through Early Access.[/b]

notes.title: COMMANDERS UPDATE
notes.notes:
Commanders Update, the first major update for You Are The Dinner, is now live.

With the Commanders Update, which is one of the important steps in the game's transformation into an RPG, the battle strategies of the base commanders will now directly affect the game style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/4583ec418749f3a65b01c1357bbbb698cb308add.png[/img]

With this update, we can choose the base commander that we will take orders from at the beginning of the game among 5 different characters. These commanders are warriors with different stories and abilities, and their strategies to fight zombies are also different from each other.

[h3]With Commanders Updates, the following changes will now also be active:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Variables on the battlefield will take shape according to the character of the base commander.
[*] Loot drop rates will be shaped by commanders.
[*] Bullet marks will now be visible. Thus, the player will have more control over the weapon.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs in Options Menu.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs in the game.
[*] The logo of the game has been revised.
[/list]

We will continue to add rich content to the game with our new updates. We will have published a detailed roadmap before the end of November.

In addition, our preparations to make our new game available on Steam at the beginning of 2023 continue from the other side.

Thank you for playing You Are The Dinner.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/18ad275e8c86e71638d4d94b3770869d7bab7ab1.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access
notes.notes:
[b][h1]We are now in Early Access[/h1][/b]

Thank you to all the players who follow You Are The Dinner.

The game has now entered the Early Access phase, and with this opportunity, we would like to briefly tell the story of You Are The Dinner.

"You Are The Dinner" was a "development tool" that we created ourselves to be a "test platform" in game development processes.

As the Indielligent team, we used this game to try out the new game techniques we developed. Over time, the game ceased to be a "tool" and turned into a fun game where we added fun highlights about the zombie culture that we were fond of and played with it in our spare time.

In the middle of 2022, we decided to share it with the players and it is now available to you.

[b][h3]What is next?[/h3][/b]

We are very happy with the "fun" factor that You Are The Dinner has achieved. And we have exciting ideas to take it even further. While we continue to work on our other game "Pirate Patrol", we will experience many new game techniques on "You Are The Dinner" and present it to our players.

In addition, we aim to increase the replayability of the game by adding new factors such as new missions, new loot objects, new weapons, new enemies, armed enemies to the game.

Thank you very much for supporting us and we hope to meet you again when not only for the "You Are The Dinner" but "Pirate Patrol", a complex Sci-Fi RPG project we are working on, comes to Steam at the end of 2022.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42981849/18ad275e8c86e71638d4d94b3770869d7bab7ab1.png[/img]

Thank you to all the players who put our game on the "Wishlist".

"[b]You Are The Dinner"[/b] was an "in-team game" that we developed as a team to play amongst ourselves, while also developing our other games, and to "test out" our new inventions at the same time.

It is inevitable that this game, which has evolved and improved over time, will evolve to new dimensions and gain new abilities while we are developing new games.
